findings.title: Mutable default argument for items leads to shared state across instances
findings.detail: Using items=[] as a default value creates a single list shared by all ShoppingCart objects, causing unexpected cross‑instance item leakage.
findings.recommendation: Change the signature to def __init__(self, items=None): and inside set self.items = [] if items is None else list(items).

findings.title: average_item_price may raise ZeroDivisionError when cart is empty
findings.detail: The method divides by len(self.items) without checking for zero, causing an exception for an empty cart.
findings.recommendation: Add a guard: if not self.items: return 0 (or raise a custom exception) before performing the division.

findings.title: add method does not validate quantity input
findings.detail: Negative or non‑numeric qty values can be added, leading to incorrect totals.
findings.recommendation: Validate that qty is a positive integer (or raise ValueError) before appending to items.

suggested_tests.title: Cart instances should maintain independent item lists
suggested_tests.rationale: Detects the mutable default argument bug where carts share the same list.

scenario.name: Independent carts maintain separate items
steps: Given two empty ShoppingCart instances cart_a and cart_b
When I add a product with qty 1 to cart_a

suggested_tests.pytest_skeleton:
def test_carts_are_independent():
    cart_a = ShoppingCart()
    cart_b = ShoppingCart()
    cart_a.add({"price": 10}, 1)
    assert cart_a.items != cart_b.items
    assert len(cart_b.items) == 0

suggested_tests.title: average_item_price handles empty cart gracefully
suggested_tests.rationale: Ensures the method does not raise ZeroDivisionError on an empty cart.

suggested_tests.title: total computes correct sum of item prices
suggested_tests.rationale: Validates core calculation logic of total method.

scenario.name: Total price calculation
steps: Given a ShoppingCart with two items: product A price 5 qty 2, product B price 3 qty 1

suggested_tests.pytest_skeleton:
def test_total_calculation():
    cart = ShoppingCart()
    cart.add({"price": 5}, 2)
    cart.add({"price": 3}, 1)
    assert cart.total() == 13

summary: The module implements basic cart functionality but has critical bugs like a mutable default argument and unsafe division on empty carts, affecting reliability and maintainability.
